name: Counter Spy

categories.label: Correct Spy guesses by you
categories.hint: 2 points each time you name the Spy card correctly.

categories.label: Wrong Spy guesses by opponent
categories.hint: 1 point to you each time your opponent guesses the Spy wrongly.

winCondition: First player to reach 3 points wins.

endCondition.description: First to 3 points; a Spy guess ends the exchange phase

notes: family: deduction. Points only come from Spy guesses: +2 for the guesser if correct, otherwise +1 to the opponent. Rules from BGG game description (publisher text); the official rulebook is an image on BGG not yet read.
